lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A spatial distribution of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the branchial region, organized into a grid of approximately 8 horizontal rows and 10 visible vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a geometric grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two continuous horizontal features on the upper third of the visible flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, high-intensity linear feature (scar) oriented diagonally across the mid-lateral flank, intersecting the primary blob constellation.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense concentration of smaller, high-luminance spots along the leading edge and distal tip of the pectoral fin.
